question:
Choose the correct meaning of the idiom 'burned the midnight oil' as used in the sentence below:

Jonathan and his friends burned the midnight oil to complete their final project.
solution:
**The correct answer is: Option 1) Worked late at night.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Burned the midnight oil** is an idiom that means to work late into the night. (रात में देर तक काम करना)

 
 
• **Example:** Jonathan and his friends burned the midnight oil to complete their final project.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Worked late at night**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their meanings:

 
• **Slept well** (अच्छी नींद ली): This means to have a good night's sleep, which is the opposite of "burning the midnight oil."
 
• **Celebrated** (मनाया): This means to engage in festivities, which is not related to the idiom "burned the midnight oil."
 
• **Lit candles** (मोमबत्तियां जलाना): Literally means to light candles, but does not capture the idiomatic meaning of "burned the midnight oil."

66:T962,
**The correct answer is: Option 2) Puts in extra effort.**
